name: JEE Advanced-style

coverage.note: Pattern and marking verified from the official JEE (Advanced) 2024 Paper 1 instructions: per subject 4 single-correct (+3/−1), 3 one-or-more-correct (+4, partial +3/+2/+1, −2), 6 non-negative integer (+4, no negative), 4 matching-list sets (+3/−1). The pattern changes every year. No year-wise difficulty or chapter data from a reliable source, so those are left empty (generic mix used). Verified 29 Oct 2026 against the cited sources.

sections.name: One or more correct (3 per subject)
sections.style: +3/+2/+1 partial marks when only correct options are chosen

sections.name: Matching list (4 per subject)
sections.style: List-I (P,Q,R,S) to List-II (1–5); one option is the correct full matching

pattern.notes: Two compulsory 3-hour papers (Paper 1 and Paper 2), 180 marks each in 2024. Paper 2 replaced matching lists with paragraph-based questions. Expect the section mix to change each year.

notes: Multi-correct partial marks: +3 if all four options are correct and only three are chosen, +2 / +1 when fewer correct options are chosen and all chosen are correct (official instructions).
Integer questions carry no negative marks.

traps: Multi-correct: choosing any wrong option gives −2 even if the others are right.
Integer questions have no negative marking — always attempt them.
Matching-list options differ by a single pair; verify every pair.
Pattern changes each year: read section instructions before starting.
